class_id: document answers recorded under a table the pull walk cannot read are invisible to the plan
feature: any consolidated writer that records a document-derived value under a table or field key which the plan-side DOC reader does not serve (today: DOC_READABLE_TABLES in field-plan-walk-doc-fetcher.ts covers ipos and ipo_details; the persister records child tables under field "rows")
